name: Emma McKeldin
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Sister of Charles "Buckey" McKeldin, named in his daughter Barbara's memoir; died before she wrote. One of the sisters who called their brother "Buckey". [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 392, 4153]
Aged 10 in the 1930 census at 1143 Carroll Street.
